# Dealer Agent Gateway

Dealer Agent Gateway is operated MCP infrastructure implementing Dealer Agent Protocol. It exposes a public, read-only surface for dealer-authorized retail inventory while keeping source credentials and dealer-private data behind the gateway boundary.

Dealer Agent Protocol is the open specification and conformance contract. Dealer Agent Gateway is the running service. The founding Howard Bentley Buick GMC pilot uses a dealer-authorized daily feed; availability and complete pricing require live dealer verification.

Dealer Agent Gateway does not expose DMS or CRM access, customer records, inventory age, stocked dates, invoice, book value, or unverified vehicle-history claims. Dealer Agent Protocol was created by Ariel Coro and is stewarded by Dealer Growth Hackers.
